{"metadata":{"description":"Codex-style code review sidebar and safe per-turn undo plugin for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1335788731","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-code-review","slug":"CooStack/dsh-code-review","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Codex-style code review sidebar and safe per-turn undo plugin for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @dsh-plugin/dsh-code-review"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A community DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for reviewing code changes turn by turn — Codex-style chan"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ge summary, resizable diff sidebar, workspace-relative file tree, syntax highlighting, and guarded u"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"mary, resizable diff sidebar, workspace-relative file tree, syntax highlighting, and guarded undo.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A community DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for reviewing code changes turn by turn. It adds a Codex-sty"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"le change summary, a resizable diff sidebar, a workspace-relative file tree, syntax highlighting, an"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"d guarded undo for safe iteration in a shared workspace."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This is an independent community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek product and does not imply D"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"eepSeek endorsement."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Turn-level review** — See added and removed line totals, open a completed turn from the conversa"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tion, and jump between changed files without leaving the chat.
- **Code and file tree together** — I"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"nspect the selected unified diff on the left and a searchable, workspace-relative file tree on the r"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ight. The inner divider is independently draggable and persisted.
- **Large, practical sidebar** — R"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"esize the review sidebar beyond the shell's former 520px cap. The layout collapses the left navigati"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"on when a narrow window needs the space and restores it when the review closes.
- **Parent and child"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" aggregation** — Changes recorded by ordinary subagents and workflow children are projected into the"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" parent review. All agents write to the same workspace immediately; no artificial merge step is intr"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"oduced.
- **Syntax-aware diffs** — Plugin-owned Shiki highlighting tokenizes complete old and new fi"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"les before mapping tokens back to diff rows, so multiline comments and strings keep their grammar st"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"ate.
- **Light and dark palettes** — Configure syntax, diff, gutter, and omitted-line colors separat"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"ely for light and dark themes.
- **Font control that does not surprise you** — Type to move the best"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" matching font candidate to the top of the menu. A font is applied only after clicking a candidate o"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"r pressing Enter. System font families can be loaded on demand through Chromium Local Font Access.
-"},{"id":"p8s15","text":" **Guarded undo** — Undo uses recorded before-and-after snapshots, resolved sandbox policy, filesyst"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"em version guards, and exact same-file content chains. Ambiguous, stale, or active-agent changes are"},{"id":"p8s17","text":" refused instead of overwritten.
- **Native DSH integration** — Uses DSH conversation nodes, session"},{"id":"p8s18","text":" utility slots, settings plugin cards, theme events, and the DSH `Menu` primitive rather than replac"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"tings plugin cards, theme events, and the DSH `Menu` primitive rather than replacing the host shell."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The repository contains the prebuilt client bundle, so a GitHub source install is enough:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart the DSH Web profile after installation so the Host and Client plugin graph is rebuilt."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To install a local checkout while developing:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The profile command forwards the package to the profile's package manager. To remove it:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"After restarting DSH Web, completed turns with recorded changes expose the `变更` utility in the conve"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rsation header. Open it to review the selected turn, search the file tree, inspect a unified diff, o"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"r open the source file in the workspace."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The conversation summary node also exposes changed files. Selecting a file opens the matching turn a"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"nd path in the review sidebar."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Open:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The card is collapsed by default and contains both settings groups:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Font** — Load system fonts, type to reorder candidates, then click or press Enter to apply one. "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Typing and clearing a draft never changes the currently applied font.
- **Code highlighting** — Edit"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" light and dark palettes independently, reset one palette, reset all overrides, and preview the resu"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"lting colors before returning to a diff."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The plugin applies the code font only to its diff renderers. The selected font and highlighter overr"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ides are persisted through the DSH `code-review` settings namespace; layout dimensions remain browse"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"r-local preferences. Existing browser-local palette data is retained only as a compatibility fallbac"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"local preferences. Existing browser-local palette data is retained only as a compatibility fallback."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Undo safety"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Undo is intentionally conservative:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- It never runs while the parent agent or an owning descendant is active.
- Every file is preflighte"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"d against the recorded final content before a write is attempted.
- Existing files use the filesyste"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"m provider's version guard.
- Concurrent same-file writes are ordered through an exact `before -> af"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ter` content chain, not callback timestamps.
- Broken chains, ambiguous same-baseline writes, extern"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"al edits, and stale snapshots return a conflict without overwriting newer work.
- Historical results"},{"id":"p28s6","text":" from before installation can be displayed when durable diff metadata exists, but they cannot be und"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"one without complete file snapshots."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Reversible snapshots are stored under:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"`npm test` covers host-side aggregation and undo safety, client registration and layout behavior, an"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"d detailed highlighter token categories. `npm run build` first compiles the TypeScript sources in `s"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"rc/` to `lib/` (with `tsc`), then regenerates `lib/client.bundle.js` via esbuild — the bundle consum"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ed by the DSH Web client."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Scope and privacy"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The plugin does not add a telemetry client, credentials flow, or background network service. Its hos"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"t side records review metadata and snapshots through DSH services; its client side uses the active D"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"SH theme and, when requested, the browser's local font enumeration API."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Copyright (C) 2026 CooStack."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (`GPL-3.0-only`)."}],"truncated":false}
